==English== {{wp}} ===Etymology=== {{etymon|en|id=place upon|:inh|enm:coveren|tree=1}} From {{inh|en|enm|coveren}}, borrowed from {{der|en|fro|covrir|covrir, cueuvrir}} (modern {{cog|fr|couvrir}}), from {{der|en|la-lat|coperire}}, from {{der|en|la|cooperiō|t=to cover completely}}, from {{m|la|co-|pos=intensive prefix}} + {{m|la|operiō|t=to close, cover}}. Displaced native {{cog|enm|thecchen}} and {{m|enm|bithecchen|bethecchen|t=to cover}} (from {{cog|ang|þeccan}}, {{m|ang|beþeccan|t=to cover}}), {{cog|enm|helen|helen, (over)helen, (for)helen|t=to cover, conceal}} (from {{cog|ang|helan|t=to conceal, cover, hide}}), {{cog|enm|wreon|wrien, (be)wreon|t=to cover}} (from {{cog|ang|wreon|(be)wrēon|t=to cover}}), {{cog|enm|hodren|hodren, hothren|t=to cover up}} (from {{cog|nds|hudren|t=to cover up}}). According to the [[w:Oxford English Dictionary|Oxford English Dictionary]], the original sense of the verb and noun {{m|en|cover}} was “hide from view” as in its [[cognate]] {{m|en|covert}}. Except in the limited sense of “cover again”, the word {{m|en|recover}} is unrelated and is cognate with {{m|en|recuperate}}. Cognate with {{cog|es|cubrir}} and {{cog|pt|cobrir}}. ===Pronunciation=== * {{IPA|en|/ˈkʌvɚ/|a=GenAm}} ** {{audio|en|en-us-cover.ogg|a=US}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈkʌvə/|a=RP,Southern England}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈkʊvə/|a=Northern England}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈkʌvəɹ/|a=Scotland,Northern Ireland}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈkʊvəɹ/|a=Ireland}} * {{IPA|en|/ˈkɐvə/|a=AU,NZ}} ** {{audio|en|en-au-cover.ogg|a=AU}} * {{a|en|Indic}} ** {{hmp|en|cower|aa=short diphthongs}} ** {{IPA|en|/kəʋər/|a=rhotic}} ** {{IPA|en|/kəʋɜː/|a=non-rhotic}} * {{rhymes|en|ʌvə(ɹ)|s=2}} ===Noun=== {{en-noun|~}} # A [[lid]]. # {{lb|en|uncountable}} Area or situation which screens a person or thing from [[view]]. #: {{ux|en|The soldiers took '''cover''' behind a ruined building.}} # The front and back of a [[book]], [[magazine]], [[compact disc|CD]] [[package]], etc. # The top [[sheet]] of a [[bed]]. # A cloth or similar material, often fitted, placed over an item such as a [[car]] or [[sofa]] or food to protect it from dust, rain, insects, etc. when not being used. # A [[cover charge]]. #: {{ux|en|There's a $15 '''cover''' tonight.}} # A [[setting]] at a [[restaurant]] table or formal [[dinner#Noun|dinner]]. #: {{ux|en|We need to set another '''cover''' for the Smith party.}} #* {{RQ:Churchill Celebrity|chapter=1|passage=When I gave a dinner there was generally a '''cover''' laid for him.
